title: Agentic Development Workflow
description: Can scope, run, verify and recover multi-step agentic coding sessions where an AI assistant reads, plans and edits code with reduced turn-by-turn supervision.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can run a single-file agentic coding session with a narrow, explicit scope and a verification check (a test or command) defined before the session starts.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can scope a multi-file agentic task with a plan reviewed before execution, and can verify the resulting diff against that plan file by file.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can diagnose when an agentic session has drifted from its stated scope or produced an incorrect plan, and can redirect or re-scope it with a narrower prompt instead of accepting the drift.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can recover a multi-step agentic session that made a destructive or incorrect change, using version control and session history to isolate and revert only the affected work while keeping what is usable.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can define a repeatable agentic workflow — verification checks, session-scoping conventions and rollback discipline — that another engineer could follow to run agentic sessions safely on a real codebase.
